properties.description: Assigns a Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge profile to a validated target. Select an authorized intersight.endpoint target. Exact organization/profile ownership, target types, assignment modes, and relationship conflicts are checked. Matching static assignments are idempotent success. Server sends ServerAssignmentMode Static; Chassis and Unified Edge send ChassisAssignmentMode Static; Domain sends SwitchAssignmentMode Static on each child. Domain validates a shared A/B device and patches children separately: B failure may leave A assigned. No automatic rollback is attempted. Inspect both children before recovery. Unified Edge uses equipment.Chassis AssignedEntity and a UCSXE- model. Each family requires live validation. Verified HTTP 2xx relationships prove assignment, not deployment.

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

profileType = sys.argv[8]
organizationName = sys.argv[9]
profileName = sys.argv[10]
targetMoid = sys.argv[11]
targetObjectType = sys.argv[12]
fabricAMoid = sys.argv[13]
fabricBMoid = sys.argv[14]

errors = []
allowedProfileTypes = {"Server", "Chassis", "Domain", "Unified Edge"}
allowedServerTargetTypes = {"compute.Blade", "compute.RackUnit"}
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

if profileType not in allowedProfileTypes:
    errors.append("Profile Type must be Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge.")
if not organizationName:
    errors.append("Profile Organization must not be blank.")
if not profileName:
    errors.append("Profile Name must not be blank.")

for label, value in (("Target Moid", targetMoid), ("Fabric A Moid", fabricAMoid), ("Fabric B Moid", fabricBMoid)):
    if value and not moidPattern.fullmatch(value):
        errors.append(label + " must be a URL-safe identifier containing only letters, digits, period, underscore, tilde, or hyphen (maximum 128 characters).")

if profileType == "Server":
    if not targetMoid:
        errors.append("Target Moid is required for a Server profile.")
    if targetObjectType not in allowedServerTargetTypes:
        errors.append("Target Object Type must be compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit for a Server profile.")
    if fabricAMoid or fabricBMoid:
        errors.append("Fabric A Moid and Fabric B Moid must be blank for a Server profile.")
elif profileType in {"Chassis", "Unified Edge"}:
    if not targetMoid:
        errors.append("Target Moid is required for a Chassis or Unified Edge profile.")
    if targetObjectType:
        errors.append("Target Object Type must be blank for a Chassis or Unified Edge profile.")
    if fabricAMoid or fabricBMoid:
        errors.append("Fabric A Moid and Fabric B Moid must be blank for a Chassis or Unified Edge profile.")
elif profileType == "Domain":
    if targetMoid or targetObjectType:
        errors.append("Target Moid and Target Object Type must be blank for a Domain profile.")
    if not fabricAMoid or not fabricBMoid:
        errors.append("Fabric A Moid and Fabric B Moid are both required for a Domain profile.")
    elif fabricAMoid == fabricBMoid:
        errors.append("Fabric A Moid and Fabric B Moid must identify distinct Fabric Interconnects.")

validationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "valid"
validationError = " ".join(errors)
validationResult = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": validationError}, separators=(",", ":"))
normalizedOrganizationName = organizationName
normalizedProfileName = profileName
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedProfileName = ""
profileCollection = ""
profileSelect = ""
platformFilter = ""
expectedProfileObjectType = ""
singleTargetUrl = ""
expectedTargetObjectType = ""

if validationStatus == "valid":
    escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[15]
    escapedProfileName = sys.argv[16]
    if profileType == "Server":
        profileCollection = "server/Profiles"
        profileSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,AssignedServer,AssociatedServer,ServerAssignmentMode,Organization,ConfigContext"
        expectedProfileObjectType = "server.Profile"
        expectedTargetObjectType = targetObjectType
        singleTargetUrl = "/api/v1/compute/Blades/" + targetMoid if targetObjectType == "compute.Blade" else "/api/v1/compute/RackUnits/" + targetMoid
    elif profileType == "Chassis":
        profileCollection = "chassis/Profiles"
        profileSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,AssignedChassis,AssociatedChassis,ChassisAssignmentMode,Organization,ConfigContext"
        expectedProfileObjectType = "chassis.Profile"
        expectedTargetObjectType = "equipment.Chassis"
        singleTargetUrl = "/api/v1/equipment/Chasses/" + targetMoid
    elif profileType == "Domain":
        profileCollection = "fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles"
        profileSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,AssignedEntity,SwitchProfiles,ChassisAssignmentMode,Organization,ConfigContext"
        platformFilter = " and TargetPlatform eq 'UCS Domain'"
        expectedProfileObjectType = "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile"
    else:
        profileCollection = "fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles"
        profileSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,AssignedEntity,SwitchProfiles,ChassisAssignmentMode,Organization,ConfigContext"
        platformFilter = " and TargetPlatform eq 'Unified Edge'"
        expectedProfileObjectType = "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile"
        expectedTargetObjectType = "equipment.Chassis"
        singleTargetUrl = "/api/v1/equipment/Chasses/" + targetMoid

properties.script:
import json
import sys
kind = sys.argv[1]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
expectedPlatform = sys.argv[4]
expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[8]
lookupStatus = 'invalid'
resourceMoid = ''
failureStatusCode = '502'
failureStatusMessage = kind + ' lookup response was malformed'
failureErrorMessage = 'The lookup response could not be validated.'
failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
    results = envelope.get('Results')
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError('The response does not contain a Results array.')
    if len(results) == 0:
        failureStatusCode = '404'
        failureStatusMessage = kind + ' was not found'
        failureErrorMessage = kind + ' lookup returned zero exact matches.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': 0}, separators=(',', ':'))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureStatusCode = '409'
        failureStatusMessage = kind + ' lookup was ambiguous'
        failureErrorMessage = kind + ' lookup returned ' + str(len(results)) + ' exact matches; exactly one is required.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': len(results)}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError('The single result is not an object.')
        resourceMoid = str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        returnedName = str(item.get('Name', '')).strip()
        returnedObjectType = str(item.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
        if not resourceMoid:
            raise ValueError('The single result does not contain a non-empty Moid.')
        if returnedName != expectedName:
            raise ValueError('The returned Name does not exactly match the normalized requested name.')
        if expectedObjectType and returnedObjectType != expectedObjectType:
            raise ValueError('The returned ObjectType does not match the selected resource type.')
        organization = item.get('Organization')
        if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedOrganizationMoid:
            raise ValueError('The returned Organization relationship does not match the resolved organization.')
        if str(organization.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'organization.Organization':
            raise ValueError('The returned Organization relationship has an unexpected ObjectType.')
        if expectedPlatform and str(item.get('TargetPlatform', '')).strip() != expectedPlatform:
            raise ValueError('The returned TargetPlatform does not match the selected profile type.')
        lookupStatus = 'valid'
        failureStatusCode = ''
        failureStatusMessage = ''
        failureErrorMessage = ''
        failureResult = '{}'
except Exception as exc:
    failureErrorMessage = 'The ' + sys.argv[9] + ' lookup response failed validation: ' + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'details': failureErrorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
if lookupStatus == 'valid':
    selectedType = sys.argv[6]
    expectedPlatformByType = {'Domain': 'UCS Domain', 'Unified Edge': 'Unified Edge'}
    expectedSelectedPlatform = expectedPlatformByType.get(selectedType, '')
    try:
        item = json.loads(sys.argv[5])['Results'][0]
        if expectedSelectedPlatform and str(item.get('TargetPlatform', '')).strip() != expectedSelectedPlatform:
            raise ValueError('The returned TargetPlatform does not match Profile Type.')
    except Exception as exc:
        lookupStatus = 'invalid'
        resourceMoid = ''
        failureStatusCode = '502'
        failureStatusMessage = 'Profile lookup response was inconsistent'
        failureErrorMessage = 'The profile lookup response failed profile-type validation: ' + str(exc)
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'details': failureErrorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
